Details 
$sparql = @'
SELECT distinct ?q ?label ?birthdate ?deathdate ?birthplace ?deathplace ?links ?descBylabel
 ?dict # ?wp ?bigEnc ?bigEncOld ?orthEnc ?wikisource ?rusBioDict ?azlibru ?proDetLit
WHERE {
  VALUES ?descBy {
     wd:Q109277660 #XVIII 
   # wd:Q109277663 #XVIII vol1
   # wd:Q110027664 #XVIII vol2
   # wd:Q110027715 #XVIII vol3
     wd:Q125555152 #XIX
    #wd:Q125555255 #XIX vol1
    #wd:Q125555366 #XIX vol2
     wd:Q124467367 #XX
    #wd:Q124510026 #XX vol1
    #wd:Q124518167 #XX vol2
    #wd:Q124518168 #XX vol3
     wd:Q108611244 #spbXX
     wd:Q106707729 #1800-1917
     wd:Q127271274 #kub1980
     wd:Q127278760 #kub2004
    }
  #{?q wdt:P1343 ?descBy. } UNION {?q wdt:P1343/wdt:P361 ?descBy.} # works, fast no dups
  {
    ?q p:P1343 ?stmt.
    ?stmt ps:P1343 ?descBy.
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?q p:P1343 ?stmt.
    ?stmt ps:P1343 ?intermediate.
    ?intermediate wdt:P361 ?descBy.
  }
  OPTIONAL { ?descBy rdfs:label ?descBylabel. FILTER ( lang(?descBylabel) = 'ru' ) }
  
  
  OPTIONAL {
  ?wp schema:about ?q . 
  ?wp schema:isPartOf <https://ru.wikipedia.org/>.
  ?wp schema:name ?title .
  }
  OPTIONAL { ?stmt pq:P1810 ?namedAs. }
  OPTIONAL { ?q rdfs:label ?labelRu. FILTER ( lang(?labelRu) = 'ru' ) }
  BIND(COALESCE(?title,?namedAs, ?labelRu) AS ?label).
  
  OPTIONAL { ?q wdt:P569 ?birthdate. }
  OPTIONAL { ?q wdt:P570 ?deathdate. }
  OPTIONAL { ?q wdt:P19 ?birthplace. }
  OPTIONAL { ?q wdt:P20 ?deathplace. }
  
  OPTIONAL {?stmt pq:P2699 ?dict. }
  
  
  OPTIONAL { ?q wikibase:sitelinks ?links. }
  }
'@

$resp = Invoke-Sparql $sparql

$ppl = Merge-ObjectArrays $resp q -SingleValueProperties birthdate,deathdate,birthplace,deathplace
Add-WikidataLabels $ppl -Property birthplace,deathplace

$ppl | ? birthdate | % {
$_.birthdate = $_.birthdate | ? {$_ -match '^\d'} | select -f 1

if ($_.birthdate) {
 $_.birthdate = $_.birthdate.Substring(0,10)
}

$p = $_
$_.psobject.properties | ? {!$_.value} | % {$p.psobject.properties.remove($_.name)}
}
$ppl | ? deathdate | % {
$_.deathdate = $_.deathdate | ? {$_ -match '^\d'} | select -f 1

if ($_.deathdate) {
 $_.deathdate = $_.deathdate.Substring(0,10)
}

$p = $_
$_.psobject.properties | ? {!$_.value} | % {$p.psobject.properties.remove($_.name)}
}

$ppl | % {$_.links = [int]$_.links}

$propIds = @'
P6385 Krugosvet
P11514 bigenc
P2924 old.bigenc
P7836 livelib
P7433 fantlab
P1233 isfdb
P12614 azlibru
#P1953 Discogs
#P1553 music.yandex
ru.wikipedia
#commons.wikimedia
ru.wikisource
Q124821483 prodetlit
'@ -split '\r?\n' -notmatch '^#' | % {($_ -split ' ')[0]}

$resp = Get-WikidataExternalUrls $ppl.q $propIds
$qToUrlsMap = $resp | group q -AsHashTable

$ppl | % {
$urls = @()
if ($tmp = $qToUrlsMap[$_.q]) {
$urls = $tmp.web
}
$urlsHref = $_.q,$_.dict+$urls | % { $short = $_ -replace '^.*?https?://(www.)?(..).*','$2'; "<a href=$_ target='_blank'>$short</a>" } | Join-String -sep ' '
Add-Member -inp $_ -NotePropertyName urlsHref -NotePropertyValue $urlsHref -Force
}

$ppl | select label,birthdate,birthplaceLabel,deathdate,deathplaceLabel,@{n='birth';e={$year = $_.birthdate.substring(0,4); [int][math]::Floor($year / 50) * 50}},links,urlsHref,descByLabel | sort links -desc | Format-HtmlTable -Description (gcb -Raw) -GroupBy descByLabel,birth -OutVariable html | Invoke-Item
0 rows
